tells.label: Trailer vanishes after passing truck
tells.detail: The blue trailer is clearly visible in frames 0-4 as the cyclist passes the truck, but by frame 5 onward the trailer is gone and only the white cab remains.

evidence.quote: visual glitches like a vanishing trailer
